name: Pokey
soft_passes: #2 intentional off-centre diagonal; sleeve bleeds to bottom-right corner, not grid-centred
#3 silhouette nameable as a hand but pointing gesture/glove-cuff split live in the white fill + keyline, lost when filled solid black
#4 16px squint: white blob + dark stalk survives on orange, but gesture and ribbed cuff smear
#9 era hybrid: modern flat gradient field under a bevel-embossed heavy-outlined cartoon glove
failures: #1 mask discipline: ~29% corner radius baked into the PNG (transparent corners) plus baked soft drop-shadow + glove bevel — an iOS/web icon ported across, not a full-bleed square for the system to mask/light
#10 variant robustness: single baked PNG, not layered Icon Composer; identity depends on the orange field, no dark/tinted/mono authoring
light_model: soft top/top-left key: glove bevel (top-left highlight to bottom-right grey) + short baked drop-shadow down-right + bg ramp lighter at top; one roughly consistent source. Shadow/bevel are baked into the art, not system-supplied
layer_stack: orange gradient field (baked rounded-rect, transparent corners)
white beveled glove with heavy black keyline
devices: pointer-cursor glove made flesh (Mickey-style white four-fingered hand = the app's subject)
diagonal reach anchored to the bottom-right corner (kinetic gesture, not centred object)
rhymes_hint: cartoon-mascot / sticker icons with a heavy black keyline on a single-hue gradient (Duolingo-adjacent hand/emoji-glyph register); and the Big-Sur single-object-on-warm-sky-ramp family, but off-centre and diagonal. Style-family guess: 'kinetic cartoon-glyph on orange ramp.' Palette rhyme: single-hue orange ramps.
notes: 400x400 web/iOS render, not the 1024 master — bevel/shadow are (estimated), coarse. This is a pre-masked iOS-style asset (baked ~115px/29% corner radius, transparent corners, baked drop-shadow + emboss), so it fails macOS-26 mask discipline (#1) outright and lacks Liquid-Glass/Icon-Composer layer authoring (#10). Strong subject-mining: the white pointer-cursor glove literally is the product ('turn your cursor into the most memorable thing on the call'). One-hue orange brand, tightly coherent with the cover (same orange, same glove, same black; cover adds hand-drawn action/burst lines for the poke/click). Charming at hero size; engineered as an iOS sticker rather than a Mac-native mark. Rubric borderline-heavy: #1 fails and #2-#4 are all soft passes — the Dock-critical band is where it is weakest.
